in_hebrew.name: במבי

in_greek.name: Μπάμπυ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπάμπυ μπορεί να προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για το 'μωρό' ή 'παιδί', και πιθανόν να συνδέεται με την ελληνική παράδοση να δίνεται το όνομα 'Μπάμπυ' στα μικρά παιδιά ως όνομα χαϊδεματιού.

data.spiritual_significance: While the name Bamby has no inherent spiritual meaning, it can be seen as a reminder of the joy and playfulness of the Christian faith. The Bible tells us that "Jesus said, 'Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for of such is the kingdom of heaven'" (Matthew 19:14). Thus, the name Bamby can be a reminder of the childlike faith and innocence that we are called to embrace as Christians. It can also serve as a reminder of the importance of finding joy and delight in our relationship with God, even in the midst of a busy and often stressful world.
